```{r}
for (nn in 1:length(list_comparisons)) {
    
    set_id = names(list_comparisons)[nn]
	
	sps_list = list_comparisons[[nn]][[1]]
	sps_ref = list_comparisons[[nn]][["ref"]]
	sps_query = sps_list [ !sps_list %in% sps_ref ]

    # color annotations
    ann_cts = c()
    for (spi in sps_list) {
		if (spi == "Spin") {
            spi_w = "Spis"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}
		ctt_spi_fn = sprintf("samap_annotation/annot.%s.leiden.csv", spi, spi)
		ctt_spi = read.table(ctt_spi_fn, header = TRUE, comment.char = "", sep = "\t")
		ann_spi_v = dic_from_vecs(sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, ctt_spi$cell_type), ctt_spi$color)
		ann_cts = c(ann_cts, ann_spi_v)
	}

	# load all ref gene from annotation
	ref_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/annot.%s.genes.csv", sps_ref, sps_ref)
	if (! file.exists(ref_genes_fn)) {
		warning(sprintf("File not found for %s: %s", sps_ref, ref_genes_fn))
		next
	}
	ref_gene_all = read.table(ref_genes_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
	ref_genes = ref_gene_all %>% mutate(sp1 = gene) %>% dplyr::select(sp1)

    # loop query species, load icc ortholog pairs
	for (spi in sps_query) {
		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s-%s ICC data...", set_id, sps_ref, spi))
		icc_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/csps/dat.icc.%s-%s.ec_scores.csv", sps_ref, sps_ref, spi)
		if (file.exists(icc_genes_fn)) {
			icc_genes_i = read.table(icc_genes_fn, header = TRUE)
			icc_genes_i = icc_genes_i [ icc_genes_i$ec_value >= min_ec, ]
		} else {
			message(sprintf("MISSING! -> %s", icc_genes_fn))
		}
		
		if (spi == sps_query[1]) {
			icc_genes_f = merge(ref_genes, icc_genes_i[,c(1,2)], by = "sp1", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
		} else {
			icc_genes_f = merge(icc_genes_f, icc_genes_i[,c(1,2)], by = "sp1", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
		}
	}
    colnames(icc_genes_f) = c(sps_ref, sps_query)
    icc_genes_f = icc_genes_f[rowSums(!is.na(icc_genes_f)) >= ortholog_fraction * ncol(icc_genes_f), ]

    fix_gene_name <- function(gene_names, prefix) {
        gene_names<-gsub("-","_", gene_names)
        ifelse(grepl(paste0("^", prefix), gene_names), gene_names, paste0(prefix, gene_names))
    }

    # loop species, load mcfp data
	for (spi in sps_list) {
        if (spi == "Spin") {
            spi_w = "Spis"
		} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {
			spi_w = "Hcoe"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}

		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s expression data...", set_id, spi))
		fps_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/dat.%s.expression.cts_fp.rds", spi, spi)
		if (file.exists(fps_genes_fn)) {
			fps_i = readRDS(fps_genes_fn)
            rownames(fps_i)<-fix_gene_name(rownames(fps_i), prefix = paste0(spi_w, "_"))
			fps_i_f = quantile_normalisation(fps_i)
		} else {
			message(sprintf("MISSING! -> %s", fps_genes_fn))
		}

		if (spi == sps_list[1]) {
			fps_i_f = fps_i_f [ icc_genes_f[,spi] , ]
			colnames(fps_i_f) = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, colnames(fps_i_f))
			csps_m = fps_i_f
		} else {
			fps_i_f_df = fps_i_f %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = spi)
			fps_i_f = icc_genes_f[, c(sps_ref, spi)] %>%
				left_join(fps_i_f_df, by = spi) %>% 
				dplyr::select(-all_of(sps_ref), -all_of(spi))
			colnames(fps_i_f) = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, colnames(fps_i_f))
			csps_m = cbind(csps_m, fps_i_f)
		}
	}

	# remove markers with an excess of absences
	csps_m = csps_m [ rowSums(!is.na(csps_m)) >= ncol(csps_m) * fraction_genes , ]
    csps_m [ is.na(csps_m) ] = 0

    ## TF筛选 ##
	list_markers_tfs = data.frame()
	for (spi in sps_list) {
         if (spi == "Spin") {
        spi_w = "Spis"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}
		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s markers...", set_id, spi))
		mks_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/seu.%s.markers.cts.csv", spi, spi)
		mks_i = read.table(mks_genes_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
		mks_i = mks_i [ !is.na(mks_i$gene) & mks_i$p_val_adj < 0.01 & mks_i$avg_log2FC > 0, ]
        gene_annotate = read.table(sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/annot.%s.genes.csv", spi, spi), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
        gene_is_tf = dic_from_vecs(gene_annotate$gene, gene_annotate$is_tf)
		mks_i$is_tf = gene_is_tf [ mks_i$gene ]

		focus_nodes = unique(mks_i$focus_node)
		for (foi in focus_nodes) {
			mks_ii = mks_i [ mks_i$focus_node == foi & mks_i$is_tf, c("gene","orthogroup") ]
			mks_ii = unique(mks_ii)
			mks_ii = mks_ii[!is.na(mks_ii$gene) & mks_ii$gene != "", , drop = FALSE]
			if (nrow(mks_ii) > 0) {
				list_markers_tfs = rbind(list_markers_tfs, data.frame(focus_node = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, foi), gene = mks_ii$gene))
			} else {
				list_markers_tfs = rbind(list_markers_tfs, data.frame(focus_node = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, foi), gene = NA))
			}
		}
	}

	# 用 TF 基因 + csps_m 的交集
	genes_for_plot = intersect(list_markers_tfs$gene, rownames(csps_m))
	
	#filter unconserved genes
	filter_genes = c("Spis_XP_022788197_1", "Spis_XP_022783463_1", "Spis_XP_022809245_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022784370_1", "Spis_XP_022782301_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022782518_1", "Spis_XP_022794362_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022792483_1", "Spis_XP_022791808_1", "Spis_XP_022807802_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022801153_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022796171_1", "Spis_XP_022809311_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022782459_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022780370_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022790819_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022801801_1", "Spis_XP_022789101_1", "Spis_XP_022792898_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022798099_1", "Spis_XP_022785281_1", "Spis_XP_022779978_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022800071_1", "Spis_XP_022784029_1", "Spis_XP_022787643_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022799559_1", "Spis_XP_022804454_1", "Spis_XP_022786538_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022782449_1", "Spis_XP_022808439_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022800909_1", "Spis_XP_022778527_1", "Spis_XP_022795122_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022795122_1", "Spis_XP_022796217_1", "Spis_XP_022791645_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022791248_1", "Spis_XP_022807320_1", "Spis_XP_022788849_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022787524_1", "Spis_XP_022804091_1", "Spis_XP_022785127_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022785127_1", "Spis_XP_022802187_1", "Spis_XP_022794775_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022794604_1", "Spis_XP_022781875_1", "Spis_XP_022794681_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022784944_1", "Spis_XP_022794008_1", "Spis_XP_022793432_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022785950_1", "Spis_XP_022789396_1", "Spis_XP_022781073_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022780929_1", "Spis_XP_022787726_1", "Spis_XP_022782200_1",
					 "Spis_XP_022780323_1", "Spis_XP_022788915_1", "Spis_XP_022802168_1")
	filter_ct = c("Spis|gastrodermis_like_2", "Spis|Neuron_lsl_Nkx6", "Spis|immune_macrophage_like_1",
				  "Fspp|unknown1", "Gfas|unknown1", "Gfas|unknown2", "Gfas|unknown3", "Pdam|unknown1", "Plut|unknown2", "Ahya|unknown1", "Ahya|unknown2", "Ahya|unknown3", "Adig|unknown5")
	genes_for_plot = genes_for_plot [ ! genes_for_plot %in% filter_genes ]
	# 固定顺序排列列：物种顺序 + 细胞类型顺序，并过滤不存在组合
	col_df <- data.frame(
	  col = colnames(csps_m),
	  spi = sub("\\|.*","", colnames(csps_m)),
	  ct  = sub(".*\\|","", colnames(csps_m)),
	  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
	)
	col_df <- col_df[col_df$spi %in% spi_order & col_df$ct %in% celltype_order, ]
	col_df$spi <- factor(col_df$spi, levels = spi_order)
	col_df$ct  <- factor(col_df$ct, levels = celltype_order)
	col_df <- col_df[order(col_df$ct, col_df$spi), ]
	ordered_cols <- col_df$col
	ordered_cols <- ordered_cols [ !(ordered_cols %in% filter_ct) ]

	csps_m_order_f = csps_m [ genes_for_plot , ordered_cols ]

	# top per metacell
    spi = sps_list[1]
    gene_annotate = read.table(sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/annot.%s.genes.csv", spi, spi), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
    gene_to_orthogroup = dic_from_vecs(gene_annotate$gene, gene_annotate$orthogroup_name)
    gene_to_uniprot = dic_from_vecs(gene_annotate$gene, gene_annotate$Uniprot_name)
	expr_m = csps_m_order_f 
	top_markers = select_top_markers(expr_m, matrix_thr = 1.5, n_top_markers = 1e6, n_markers_rollmean = 2)
	expr_m = expr_m [ top_markers, ]
	top_cl_per_gene = colnames(expr_m) [ apply(expr_m, 1, which.max) ]
	rownames(expr_m) = sprintf("%s | %s", rownames(expr_m), gene_to_uniprot[rownames(expr_m)]) 
	rownames(expr_m) = stringr::str_trunc(rownames(expr_m), 100)

	pp1 = plot_complex_heatmap(
		expr_m,
		name = "Footprint",
		cluster_row = FALSE,
		cluster_col = FALSE,
		use_raster = FALSE,
		color_min = 1,
		color_max = 4,
		color_mat = c("gray95","orange","orangered2","#520c52"),
		cell_border = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1, lty = 1),
		heatmap_border = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, lty = 1),
		categories_row = top_cl_per_gene,
		categories_col = colnames(expr_m),
		colors_row = ann_cts,
		colors_col = ann_cts,
		fontsize = 6
	)

	pdfheight = max(4, (nrow(expr_m)/8 + 6))
	pp1@matrix_param$width  = unit(ncol(expr_m)/10, "in")
	pp1@matrix_param$height = unit(nrow(expr_m)/10, "in")
	pdf(sprintf("%s/csps.%s.fixed_ordered_heatmap_TFs_filtered.pdf", out_fn, set_id), width = 30, height = pdfheight)
	print(pp1)
	dev.off()

	## Save matrix ##
	saveRDS(csps_m, sprintf("%s/csps.%s.cspsmatrix.%s.rds", out_fn, set_id, focid))
}
```

```{r}
ortholog_fraction = 0.1
fraction_genes = 0
# identify icc markers
min_ec = 0

selected_Uniprot = c("USF2", "FOXB1", "ARI5A", "ARI5B", "PO4F1", "PRD13", "ARID3", "SIX2",

    icc_genes_f = icc_genes_f[rowSums(!is.na(icc_genes_f)) >= ortholog_fraction * ncol(icc_genes_f), ]

    fix_gene_name <- function(gene_names, prefix) {
        gene_names<-gsub("-","_", gene_names)
        ifelse(grepl(paste0("^", prefix), gene_names), gene_names, paste0(prefix, gene_names))
    }

    # loop species, load mcfp data
	for (spi in sps_list) {
        if (spi == "Spin") {
            spi_w = "Spis"
		} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {

			fps_i_f = quantile_normalisation(fps_i)

	filter_ct = c("Spis|gastrodermis_like_2", "Spis|Neuron_lsl_Nkx6", "Spis|immune_macrophage_like_1",
				  "Fspp|unknown1", "Gfas|unknown1", "Gfas|unknown2", "Gfas|unknown3", "Pdam|unknown1", "Plut|unknown2", "Ahya|unknown1", "Ahya|unknown2", "Ahya|unknown3", "Adig|unknown5")
	genes_for_plot = genes_for_plot [ ! genes_for_plot %in% filter_genes ]

	col_df <- data.frame(

    gene_to_uniprot = dic_from_vecs(gene_annotate$gene, gene_annotate$Uniprot_name)
	expr_m = csps_m_order_f 
	top_markers = select_top_markers(expr_m, matrix_thr = 1.5, n_top_markers = 1e6, n_markers_rollmean = 2)
	expr_m = expr_m [ top_markers, ]
	top_cl_per_gene = colnames(expr_m) [ apply(expr_m, 1, which.max) ]
	rownames(expr_m) = sprintf("%s | %s", rownames(expr_m), gene_to_uniprot[rownames(expr_m)]) 
	rownames(expr_m) = stringr::str_trunc(rownames(expr_m), 100)

	pp1 = plot_complex_heatmap(

		name = "Footprint",

		categories_row = top_cl_per_gene,
		categories_col = colnames(expr_m),
		colors_row = ann_cts,
		colors_col = ann_cts,
		fontsize = 6
	)

	pdfheight = max(4, (nrow(expr_m)/8 + 6))
	pp1@matrix_param$width  = unit(ncol(expr_m)/10, "in")
	pp1@matrix_param$height = unit(nrow(expr_m)/10, "in")
	pdf(sprintf("%s/csps.%s.fixed_ordered_heatmap_TFs_selected.pdf", out_fn, set_id), width = 30, height = pdfheight)
	print(pp1)
	dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
# completeness
ortholog_fraction = 0.8
fraction_genes = 0.7

# identify icc markers
min_ec = 0

for (nn in 1:length(list_comparisons)) {
    
    set_id = names(list_comparisons)[nn]
	
	sps_list = list_comparisons[[nn]][[1]]
	sps_ref = list_comparisons[[nn]][["ref"]]
	sps_query = sps_list [ !sps_list %in% sps_ref ]

    # color annotations
    ann_cts = c()
    for (spi in sps_list) {
		if (spi == "Spin") {
            spi_w = "Spis"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}
		ctt_spi_fn = sprintf("samap_annotation/annot.%s.leiden.csv", spi, spi)
		ctt_spi = read.table(ctt_spi_fn, header = TRUE, comment.char = "", sep = "\t")
		ann_spi_v = dic_from_vecs(sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, ctt_spi$cell_type), ctt_spi$color)
		ann_cts = c(ann_cts, ann_spi_v)
	}

	# load all ref gene from annotation
	ref_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/annot.%s.genes.csv", sps_ref, sps_ref)
	if (! file.exists(ref_genes_fn)) {
		warning(sprintf("File not found for %s: %s", sps_ref, ref_genes_fn))
		next
	}
	ref_gene_all = read.table(ref_genes_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
	ref_genes = ref_gene_all %>% mutate(sp1 = gene) %>% dplyr::select(sp1)

    # loop query species, load icc ortholog pairs
	for (spi in sps_query) {
		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s-%s ICC data...", set_id, sps_ref, spi))
		icc_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/csps/dat.icc.%s-%s.ec_scores.csv", sps_ref, sps_ref, spi)
		if (file.exists(icc_genes_fn)) {
			icc_genes_i = read.table(icc_genes_fn, header = TRUE)
			icc_genes_i = icc_genes_i [ icc_genes_i$ec_value >= min_ec, ]
		} else {
			message(sprintf("MISSING! -> %s", icc_genes_fn))
		}
		
		if (spi == sps_query[1]) {
			icc_genes_f = merge(ref_genes, icc_genes_i[,c(1,2)], by = "sp1", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
		} else {
			icc_genes_f = merge(icc_genes_f, icc_genes_i[,c(1,2)], by = "sp1", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
		}
	}
    colnames(icc_genes_f) = c(sps_ref, sps_query)
    icc_genes_f = icc_genes_f[rowSums(!is.na(icc_genes_f)) >= ortholog_fraction * ncol(icc_genes_f), ]

    fix_gene_name <- function(gene_names, prefix) {
        gene_names<-gsub("-","_", gene_names)
        ifelse(grepl(paste0("^", prefix), gene_names), gene_names, paste0(prefix, gene_names))
    }

    # loop species, load mcfp data
	for (spi in sps_list) {
        if (spi == "Spin") {
            spi_w = "Spis"
		} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {
			spi_w = "Hcoe"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}

		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s expression data...", set_id, spi))
		fps_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/dat.%s.expression.cts_fp.rds", spi, spi)
		if (file.exists(fps_genes_fn)) {
			fps_i = readRDS(fps_genes_fn)
            rownames(fps_i)<-fix_gene_name(rownames(fps_i), prefix = paste0(spi_w, "_"))
			fps_i_f = quantile_normalisation(fps_i)
		} else {
			message(sprintf("MISSING! -> %s", fps_genes_fn))
		}

		if (spi == sps_list[1]) {
			fps_i_f = fps_i_f [ icc_genes_f[,spi] , ]
			colnames(fps_i_f) = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, colnames(fps_i_f))
			csps_m = fps_i_f
		} else {
			fps_i_f_df = fps_i_f %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = spi)
			fps_i_f = icc_genes_f[, c(sps_ref, spi)] %>%
				left_join(fps_i_f_df, by = spi) %>% 
				dplyr::select(-all_of(sps_ref), -all_of(spi))
			colnames(fps_i_f) = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, colnames(fps_i_f))
			csps_m = cbind(csps_m, fps_i_f)
		}
	}

	# remove markers with an excess of absences
	csps_m = csps_m [ rowSums(!is.na(csps_m)) >= ncol(csps_m) * fraction_genes , ]
    csps_m [ is.na(csps_m) ] = 0

    ## TF筛选 ##
	list_markers_tfs = data.frame()
	for (spi in sps_list) {
         if (spi == "Spin") {
        spi_w = "Spis"
		} else {
			spi_w = spi
		}
		message(sprintf("csps %s | load %s markers...", set_id, spi))
		mks_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/seu.%s.markers.cts.csv", spi, spi)
		mks_i = read.table(mks_genes_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
		mks_i = mks_i [ !is.na(mks_i$gene) & mks_i$p_val_adj < 0.01 & mks_i$avg_log2FC > 0, ]
        gene_annotate = read.table(sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/annot.%s.genes.csv", spi, spi), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
        gene_is_tf = dic_from_vecs(gene_annotate$gene, gene_annotate$is_tf)
		mks_i$is_tf = gene_is_tf [ mks_i$gene ]

		focus_nodes = unique(mks_i$focus_node)
		for (foi in focus_nodes) {
			mks_ii = mks_i [ mks_i$focus_node == foi & mks_i$is_tf, c("gene","orthogroup") ]
			mks_ii = unique(mks_ii)
			mks_ii = mks_ii[!is.na(mks_ii$gene) & mks_ii$gene != "", , drop = FALSE]
			if (nrow(mks_ii) > 0) {
				list_markers_tfs = rbind(list_markers_tfs, data.frame(focus_node = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, foi), gene = mks_ii$gene))
			} else {
				list_markers_tfs = rbind(list_markers_tfs, data.frame(focus_node = sprintf("%s|%s", spi_w, foi), gene = NA))
			}
		}
	}
}
```
